candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - Environment Agency data coverage
verified_facts: EA directs users to its index catalogue to identify coverage for different LiDAR products by grid square.
Coverage lookup is a discovery step before selecting survey data.
semantic_limits: Coverage/index presence does not identify a composite contributing survey or provide an elevation value.

candidates.name: OGC MetOcean Application profile for WCS 2.1 - Part 0 Metadata
verified_facts: The profile identifies WCS 2.1 core GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage operations.
It lists Range Subsetting, Scaling, Interpolation and CRS extensions as separable WCS capabilities.
semantic_limits: Extension support describes service capability and does not validate a particular elevation value.

candidates.name: OGC MetOcean GetCorridor Extension
verified_facts: GetCorridor is built on WCS 2.1 and its range, scaling, interpolation and CRS extensions.
When interpolation is required the profile exposes global or per-axis interpolation properties.
semantic_limits: A profile example is used to prove interpolation must be explicit, not to define EA parcel sampling behavior.

candidates.name: OGC MetOcean GetPolygon Extension
verified_facts: The extension builds polygon coverage extraction on WCS 2.1 and coverage-processing extensions.
Its dependency list separates range subsetting, scaling, interpolation and CRS behavior.
semantic_limits: Polygon extraction capability is processing semantics and is not evidence that an EA WCS response was processed this way.

candidates.name: WCS Transaction Extension 2.0
verified_facts: The standard defines InsertCoverage, DeleteCoverage and UpdateCoverage for modifying server coverage offerings.
Updates must preserve internal coverage consistency.
semantic_limits: Transactional mutation capability is excluded from the read-only reproducible sampling path used by this slot.

candidates.name: Web Coverage Processing Service 1.0
verified_facts: WCPS defines server-side expressions over coverages including field/range selection.
Coverage processing can derive a result while preserving or changing coverage constituents according to the operation.
semantic_limits: Processed WCPS outputs are not silently treated as native EA DTM samples.

candidates.name: OGC Web Services Security
verified_facts: The standard references WCS protocol bindings and security-gateway behavior for OGC web services.
Transport/security concerns are orthogonal to coverage processing semantics.
semantic_limits: HTTPS/security compliance does not alter or certify raster elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: OGC Testbed 20 GeoDataCube API Profile Report
verified_facts: The report compares WCS scaling and range-subsetting capabilities with newer geodata-cube API approaches.
It treats server-side computation as a separate capability rather than an inherent property of source values.
semantic_limits: An OGC engineering report is non-normative and is used only for architecture/role separation.

candidates.name: OGC Testbed 17 Geo Data Cube API Engineering Report
verified_facts: The report describes coverage tiles as equivalent to coverage requests using specific subsetting and scaling combinations.
It separately identifies range subsetting and filtering as processing capabilities.
semantic_limits: The report is non-normative and cannot prove EA tile values are native or unscaled.

candidates.name: OGC Testbed 12 REST Architecture Engineering Report
verified_facts: The report maps WCS capabilities, coverage descriptions, subsets and metadata to REST resources.
It distinguishes read-only retrieval from transactional coverage modification.
semantic_limits: REST architecture is non-normative implementation guidance and not terrain evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Documentation
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 is a 50m-post-spacing terrain product with grid and contour forms.
The documentation states annual July updates and Great Britain coverage.
semantic_limits: Terrain 50 is far too coarse to replace the 1m EA parcel extrema workflow.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 source data
verified_facts: OS Terrain grid and contour products are interpolated from a source TIN.
Terrain 50 applies more generalised representation because it is designed for small-scale products.
semantic_limits: TIN interpolation/generalisation makes Terrain 50 a broad secondary check, not primary sub-metre evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 product supply
verified_facts: Grid data is supplied at 50m spacing and contour data at 10m intervals in multiple formats.
The product is supplied by annual full-tile resupply.
semantic_limits: Supply cadence and packaging do not establish acquisition time or parcel-level accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 grid data technical specification
verified_facts: Terrain 50 grid pixels are 50m by 50m and height values are associated with pixel centers.
Stored height values are given to the nearest 0.1m.
semantic_limits: 0.1m storage precision is not 0.1m accuracy; 50m cells cannot validate parcel extrema.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 data structure
verified_facts: Grid values are calculated at pixel centers.
Tidal-water modelling can produce small discrete steps between adjacent tiles and foreshore heights are interpolated.
semantic_limits: Coastal interpolation/tile-edge behavior is a modelling artifact and not parcel ground truth.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 technical specification
verified_facts: Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution DTM distributed as 50m grid and 10m contours.
The technical specification separates grid, contour, GeoPackage, vector-tile and metadata encodings.
semantic_limits: Format availability and product scope do not increase source terrain accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Esri Shapefile specification
verified_facts: Terrain 50 contour/spot-height shapefiles are non-topological vector encodings.
Per-tile metadata is supplied separately from geometry.
semantic_limits: Vector file topology/format is not a numeric elevation-accuracy guarantee.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 GeoPackage specification
verified_facts: Terrain 50 contours can be supplied as a national GeoPackage with separate spot-height, boundary and contour layers.
GeoPackage is an encoding/container choice for the vector terrain product.
semantic_limits: GeoPackage container benefits do not imply improved terrain accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 pre-requisites
verified_facts: OS describes Terrain 50 as inert data supplied without manipulation software.
GML or other formats may require GIS translation/processing by the user.
semantic_limits: Client software behavior must not be confused with source acquisition or accuracy.

candidates.name: Data Services Platform FAQ index
verified_facts: The official DSP support index routes users to Survey Data Catalogue, platform, licensing and metadata guidance.
It is the authority-routing entry point for current support material.
semantic_limits: A support index provides routing/currentness only and is not numeric terrain evidence.
